title: Cross-scale organisation of the atmospheric circulation: a falsification-grade research programme (Shroedinger, gen4)
description:
v6.4 — paper 3 of the series: the law of inheritance between scale levels, journal-format manuscript and a single reproduction script. Numerical results of all earlier frozen experiments are identical to v6.0.

  • manuscript_v2/article3/article3_v2.pdf (source article3_v2_src.tex) — paper 3, “Hierarchy of the atmospheric circulation: the law of inheritance between scale levels and its meaning for regionalisation” (in Russian, journal format): the beyond-spectrum covariance of log-envelopes of two scale bands depends only on the coarser band (common-ancestor structure), on 48 regional units, 902 global tiles and a free-running IFS-HR run; the adjacent-level coupling of papers 1–2 is its normalised amplitude; consequences for regionalisation.
  • Phases 27–30 (frozen protocols in docs/PROTOCOL_PHASE27..30_*.md, code clean_experiments/experiment_B27..B30_*.py, results and reports in clean_experiments/results/): mechanism test (PARTIAL), inheritance depth (law form confirmed, depth withdrawn as a ladder artefact), structure law replication and model run, unification P ↔ law.
  • reproducibility/reproduce_article3.py — single entry point for paper 3 (--stage download | compute | figures | manuscript | check | all), route per result in reproducibility/article3_README.md, SHA-256 of 6 artifacts.
  • Literature review and adversarial prior-art search for paper 3 (docs/LIT_REVIEW_ARTICLE3_MECHANISM.md); 15 new verified entries in the master bibliography.

Raw ERA5 / MERRA-2 / HighResMIP fields are deliberately not stored; the exact download scripts and all derived tables are included. Author rules of the target journal are referenced, not redistributed (docs/journal/README.md).
notes: Supersedes release v6.2. Adds paper 2 (journal-format manuscript v4), its single reproduction script, the descriptive layer and Phase 25; repository manuscripts reorganised per article. Frozen numerical results unchanged since v6.0.
